correctness.rationale: Each internal degree-three path vertex sees hub and two distance-two vertices, which must have mutually distinct colours; the hub colour never occurs on the path, and c(v_{i+2})≠c(v_i). Hub demand caps each path-colour frequency at floor(n/2). Two available path colours cannot cover odd n within that cap. On even n the forced period-four binary word gives exactly 12 or 6 named solutions; on odd n the two parity-index paths are independently properly 3-coloured, and coefficient extraction enforces the frequency cap. Direct open-neighbourhood enumeration reproduced n=2:6,3:24,4:12,5:192,6:6,7:912,8:12. Edge case n=2 is K3.
